noise_allowance_basis: Conservative engineering allowance: rounded up from twice the largest 1.38 uA held-out zero-input residual. Not a statistical confidence interval. Signed near-zero readings are retained; target qualification uses the adverse bound.
method: Mean of three independent same-node captures at the nominal 0.5 V read operating point; subtract signed differential offset, without clipping negative results.
scope: A12-A13 READ measurements only; not SET/RESET pulse currents or other read voltages. Revalidate after changing probes, instrument, or measurement setup.
